## v0.5.13 · Workspace, Builtin and DSH 0.1.7 Compatibility

- [#268](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/268) rejects Windows workspace paths below regular files before computing storage identities. Valid identities are preserved; existing storage is not moved or deleted.
- [#269](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/269) hides only the owning conversation's width handles while Builtin memory is open. The composer remains usable, and returning to Chat restores width dragging.
- [#270](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/pull/270) supports DSH 0.1.7-alpha.1 live Config settings, icon exports and Session message sources, while retaining older hosts and historical Mnemon message deduplication. Profile settings keep revision checks, explicit choices and native expressions.

### Packages and upgrade

Only **dsh-mnemon advances to 0.5.13**; all sixteen companion plugins retain their versions. Compatibility evidence covers unchanged public DSH 0.1.5-rc.2, 0.1.6-alpha.2 and 0.1.7-alpha.1 packages. The Client floor remains 0.1.5-rc.1; Mnemon CLI remains independently maintained.

Back up the DSH profile configuration, legacy settings and relevant Mnemon data before upgrading.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mnemon@0.5.13
```

Restart DSH and reload the browser; use `headless` for that Profile. If DSH first imports an original `settings.yaml`, Mnemon's supplemental UI/View recovery waits for the next cold Host start and can require a second complete stop/start. A browser refresh is insufficient. Recovery preserves `settings.yaml.imported` and requires the canonical `mnemon` root with the exact owning profile namespace; it does not guess custom roots or foreign suffixes.

Downgrades need the matching configuration backup and manual reconciliation of later changes. New settings have no automatic reverse export. Runtime, Documents and Memory Spaces data formats are unchanged.

### 中文说明

本版包含三项修复：Windows 工作区路径如果位于普通文件之下，会在计算存储标识前被拒绝，合法标识与已有存储保持不变；Builtin 记忆页仅隐藏所属对话的宽度手柄，常驻输入框仍可用，返回 Chat 后恢复拖拽；适配 DSH 0.1.7-alpha.1 的实时 Config 设置、图标与 Session 消息来源，同时保留旧宿主兼容、历史消息去重、设置修订检查、当前显式选择和原生表达式。

仅主包升级至 0.5.13，十六个配套插件版本不变。兼容证据覆盖未修改的公开 DSH 0.1.5-rc.2、0.1.6-alpha.2 和 0.1.7-alpha.1，Client 下限仍为 0.1.5-rc.1，Mnemon CLI 独立维护。升级前备份 Profile 配置、旧设置及相关数据，升级后重启 DSH 并刷新浏览器。首次由 DSH 导入原始 `settings.yaml` 后，Mnemon 补充 UI/View 恢复会延后到下一次冷启动，可能需要第二次完整停止并启动 Host；仅刷新页面不够。

恢复保留 `settings.yaml.imported` 原件，只接受标准 `mnemon` 根 Entry 与所属 Profile 的精确命名空间，不猜测自定义根或其他 Profile 的后缀。降级需要对应配置备份，并手动核对后续更改；没有自动逆向导出。Runtime、Documents 和 Memory Spaces 数据格式不变。

The implementation evidence covers [native Windows paths](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.13/docs/pr-assets/issue-266-workspace-ancestor/README.md), [Builtin interaction](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.13/docs/pr-assets/issue-265-builtin-width-handles/README.md), and [DSH settings, recovery and Sessions](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.13/docs/pr-assets/issue-267-settings-migration/README.md). Model responses use an explicit loopback fixture without an external model API key; tools, storage and browser operations are real. 发布证据覆盖原生 Windows 路径、Builtin 交互及 DSH 设置、恢复与 Session；模型使用本地夹具，工具、存储和浏览器操作真实执行。

The release workflow must verify the versioned artifacts, full Registry composition and an actual v0.4.7 upgrade before creating this Release. 发布工作流须完成版本化制品、完整 Registry 组合及 v0.4.7 真实升级检查，之后才创建此 Release。

See [English release notes](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.13/docs/en/releases/v0.5.13.md) and [中文发布说明](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-mnemon/blob/v0.5.13/docs/zh-CN/releases/v0.5.13.md).
